card.name: Words just before a predicted outcome
card.fires_on: Linking words such as likely, that, which, not and of, placed where a clause about a future or probable outcome is about to follow. It is strongest in 'is likely to' and 'chance that you are going to'.

modes.label: Likely before an outcome
modes.description: The word likely after is, not or will, leading into a predicted event.
modes.example: Once lightning discovers an easy target it will<< likely>> strike again.

modes.label: That or which introducing a prediction
modes.description: A linking word such as that or which introduces a clause about what may happen.
modes.example: “If you live to be 85, there’s about a 50 percent chance<< that>> you are going to have Alzheimer's disease

modes.label: Other lead-ins to a verb
modes.description: Words like of or not that set up a verb about to come.
modes.example: Signifies one<< of>> the most important stories of the day,

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'will' and not with present-tense verbs like 'gets' or 'develops'.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into a prediction, where 'will' is likely to come next.
